name: resilient-research-app
description: AI-powered research intelligence platform for systematic reviews, evidence synthesis, and academic writing.
author: Resilient Research App

scripts.dist: rm -rf dist-electron .next/standalone/dist-electron && next build && rm -rf .next/standalone/dist-electron && find .next/standalone -type l -exec sh -c 'cp -rL "$1" "$1.tmp" 2>/dev/null && rm "$1" && mv "$1.tmp" "$1"' _ {} \; && electron-builder --publish never
